sm: This Apologetics Press video argues that atheism fails because of five implications it carries. First, it says atheism implies there is no free will, quoting William Provine, Sam Harris and Anthony Cashmore, and it counters that choosing to watch the video shows free will exists. Second, without free will there is no moral responsibility, citing Jerry Coyne, yet people feel real guilt. Third, atheism allows no objective right and wrong, citing Darwin and Sartre. Fourth, it makes life meaningless, citing Alex Rosenberg, Graham Lawton and Dan Barker. Fifth, it rules out anything spiritual, reducing love and virtue to gene survival, as Richard Dawkins describes. The video concludes with C.S. Lewis, saying atheism turns out to be too simple.
